reserveReview.rationale: The official Morpho app identifies this exact deployment as version 2.0 with asset USDT; asset() independently returned USDT at Ethereum block 26095798 on 2026-10-01. Matched VaultV2 source allocates through adapters rather than a V1 withdrawal queue. User deposits mint shares against USDT; fee accrual can also mint fee shares. The existing 100% slice describes the USDT-denominated strategy claim, not a measured current distribution across lending markets.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The direct vault is immutable Morpho V2 code, not MetaMorpho V1. At Ethereum block 26095798, its sole adapter and liquidityAdapter were 0x1c87feac33e2ad0a81a250fa63db4b1c2687bb05. The issuer describes a noncustodial lending strategy. This review does not establish provider shares, legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or a current borrower-collateral split. The existing segregation category remains an interpretation of pooled lending, not a separately verified legal term. On 2026-10-01, ruling D10 separates strategy deployment from legal reuse rights: the governing vault terms establish a noncustodial curator but neither permit nor prohibit custodian reuse, so rehypothecation is unknown.
